grain_rationale: One source row is one invoice line event: the profile reports row_count 44721 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist and no roll-up is required. No single column is unique on its own (the largest distinct_count is stock_code at 3141 and invoice_id at 2330, both far below row_count 44721), so a derived identity over invoice_id, stock_code, invoiced_at, quantity and unit_price is used; because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 this tuple needs no duplicate absorption and distinguishes repeated stock codes within the same invoice by their timestamp, quantity and price.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Identifier of the invoice the line belongs to, stored as text with 2330 distinct values and null_rate 0.0 (samples such as '489434', '489435'), labelling rather than measuring so it is a dimension.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Flag marking a line as a cancellation or return, with distinct_values [false, true] and null_rate 0.0, used to segment lines rather than to be summed.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product stock code of the line, 3141 distinct values with null_rate 0.0 (samples '10002', '10002R', '10080'), an identifying code and therefore a dimension.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product label with 3034 distinct values and null_rate 0.005098, so it is nullable where the source line carried no description (samples such as '11 PC CERAMIC TEA SET POLKADOT').

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Number of units on the line, null_rate 0.0 with min -1395 and max 5184, additive across rows and negative for returns so it is a measure.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp the invoice line was issued, null_rate 0.0 and ranging from 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00, the event time of the category.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per unit on the line, null_rate 0.0 with min 0.0 and max 1998.49, a numeric amount compared and aggregated across rows so it is a measure.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric identifier of the purchasing customer with 1045 distinct values ranging 12346 to 18287; it is nullable at null_rate 0.300664 because many lines carry no customer attribution, and it labels rather than measures so it is a dimension.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country associated with the invoice line, a low-cardinality label with 24 distinct values and null_rate 0.0 (samples 'Australia', 'EIRE', 'France').

category_description: One row is one invoice line event: a single product (stock_code) billed on a single invoice (invoice_id) at a given timestamp, carrying the quantity and unit price for that line together with its customer and country context and its cancellation flag.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_invoice_lines enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category: it names the event time column and grain, the transaction grain and its derived line identity, and the role and type of every mapped silver column. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which reads the contract and emits the gold models; the mapping itself creates no object.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; once approved the modeling engine uses it to generate the invoice_lines fact and its conformed context, keyed on the derived line_identity at minute grain on invoiced_at.
limitations: The mapping names columns only: it renames nothing, filters nothing, and derives nothing beyond the line_identity tuple. Cancellation lines are mapped and not excluded, so consumers that must drop returns filter on is_cancellation (distinct_values false and true) or on negative quantity (min -1395) themselves. Lines without customer attribution remain in scope because customer_id is nullable at null_rate 0.300664, and no monetary line total is computed since only quantity and unit_price are profiled. No quality rules, classifications, service levels, ownership, or access policies are proposed; those belong to review.
